purpose: Define the first descriptive Smart-Money value review before seeing Kraken-EUR outcome results, preventing threshold/coin/wallet cherry-picking.

fixed_event_definition.direction_rule: wallet net exposure-change notional from Hyperliquid fill directions; one wallet counts once per asset/window regardless of fill count
fixed_event_definition.single_wallet_high_frequency_guard: raw fill count cannot increase independent-wallet count
fixed_event_definition.eligible_asset_rule: later Kraken join only if the asset maps point-in-time to an online Kraken Spot-EUR pair; no retrospective inclusion based on outcome

first_review_outputs: multi-wallet consensus count by asset without winner ranking
directional Kraken-EUR MFE/MAE/close at fixed horizons
lead-time distribution using Hyperliquid source fill timestamp
false-positive rate under one frozen outcome label
incremental comparison against contemporaneous Kraken price/volume/orderflow context
prohibited_before_gate: coin subset selection by observed performance
next_gate_if_mature: Render evidence-only H10 review, classify KEEP/REJECT/MORE_TESTING without changing active strategy; only then preregister one candidate feature if justified.
